Method of Attack: Memory corruption issues in Intel PRO / 1000 MT Desktop (82540EM) network card (E1000) when network mode is set to NAT
Allows a malicious program with root/administrator rights in the guest OS to escape and execute arbitrary code in the application layer (ring 3) of the host OS
Privilege escalation to kernel privileges (ring 0) on the host machine via /dev/vboxdrv
Attack Vector: Exploitation of E1000 vulnerability in VirtualBox with root/administrator privileges in guest OS
Indicators of Compromise: Details of the zero-day vulnerability and exploit chain published on GitHub
Video demonstration of the attack released on Vimeo
